note: The agent sources a .env to run the app, then checks whether an internal host is reachable with `nc -z` and later writes a connector whose docstring holds the API URL. `nc -z` is a port probe, not an upload, and a URL inside a heredoc body is not an outbound connection; both were counted as the second step of CHAIN_SECRET_TO_EXFIL (CRITICAL) and as POTENTIAL_DATA_EXFILTRATION (HIGH). Nine of fifteen CRITICAL chains on a real machine had this shape.

allow.SENSITIVE_FILE_READ: sourcing .env is a sensitive read by design (MEDIUM); the case is about what came after
allow.UNEXPECTED_NETWORK_DESTINATION: LOW, allowlist question, not this case
